title: Rollout metrics huddle — UI, rollouts & analytics (2026-04-02)
content:
Meeting: Rollout metrics huddle (recurring)
Date: 2026-04-02 09:30 PT (30m)
Owner / note taker: Maya Chen
Attendees: Maya, Tom, Priya, Lena, Shawn, Diego (joined late)

Purpose: quick sync across UI, rollout orchestration, and analytics to triage metric anomalies and finalize canary thresholds for adaptive-fallback experiment.

High-level updates
- UI (Priya): delta-config editor UX prototype handed off. Flow now supports inline validation for JSON/typed fields and shows rollback diff. Prototype PR landed; still missing keyboard shortcuts and i18n strings.
  - PR: github.com/redwood/console/pull/6209 (in review, request changes: keyboard shortcuts + aria labels)
  - TODO: Priya to follow up with design on microcopy for fallback prompt (due 2026-04-07).

- Rollouts (Tom): adaptive-fallback feature gate turned on for internal staging yesterday. Canary run produced mixed results: p50 latency improved ~12% but error ratio for streaming responses increased in eu-west-1. We rolled canary to 20% traffic then paused.
  - Observed spike in streaming error codes (ERR_STREAM_RESET) around 06:20 UTC. Investigating correlation with autoscaler events.
  - Rollout ticket: JIRA-ROLL-204.

- Analytics (Lena & Diego): pipeline lag reduced from ~7m to ~2m after ingestion batch tuning. However, two dashboards mis-attribute token counts when a fallback model is invoked (counts recorded against primary model id).
  - Fix plan: add event flag (model_variant) to ingestion schema, deliver patch by 2026-04-05. Ticket: JIRA-ANALYTICS-78.

Observations / recent incidents
- Telemetry anomaly: p95 token processing in eu-west-1 increased by 40% for requests with >1024 token context. Root cause hypothesis: kernel selection fallback to generic matmul path under quantized config. SRE already captured debug traces.
- Canary was paused automatically by the rollout controller when error budget crossed threshold (0.8%). This demonstrates the controller's circuit-breaker is working, but we need clearer signals surfaced in the Console.

Decisions made
- Pause canary rollout for adaptive-fallback and create a shim to force-stream graceful errors rather than stream-resets for a second canary run. Reason: stream resets cause client-side retries and inflate observed token counts. (Owner: Tom, by 2026-04-03)
- Add a dedicated 'Canary anomalies' section to the rollouts dashboard and surface most recent abort reason in the rollout details view. (Owner: Priya + Lena, prototype by 2026-04-09)
- Analytics ingestion will include model_variant flag; backfill for last 7 days will be scheduled if patch verified. (Owner: Diego, plan by 2026-04-05)

Blockers and risks
- Blocker: staging autoscaler logs for the timeframe contain redacted GPU model identifiers—needs SRE access to unredacted logs to confirm whether kernel fallback correlates to a specific instance type. (Blocked on SRE: Shawn)
- Risk: rolling fixes quickly without backfilled metrics will bias cost/latency dashboards; we must mark experiment windows clearly. (Action: mark experiment windows in Console; Owner: Priya)

Action items (who / what / due)
- Tom: implement 'graceful stream error' shim in rollout controller & trigger second canary at 10% (eu-west-1) — due 2026-04-03
- Priya: design and wireframe 'Canary anomalies' panel + add abort reason to rollout details — due 2026-04-09
- Lena: add model_variant field to ingestion schema; prototype change to ETL — due 2026-04-05
- Diego: run a targeted backfill plan if schema change is validated; estimate cost and time — due 2026-04-07
- Shawn: request SRE unredacted logs for 06:00-07:00 UTC 2026-04-01 and share to thread — due 2026-04-03
- Maya: coordinate post-mortem notes and update rollout playbook (confluence://ConsoleRollouts/metrics-playbook) with new thresholds — due 2026-04-06

Notes-to-self / loose ideas (informal)
- Consider adding a small 'delta preview' when editing rollout config to show expected change in estimated cost and p95 impact (rough calc based on historical shards). Could live in the delta-config editor.
- If we expose abort reason, include an expandable raw telemetry view (for devs only) that links to trace IDs. Ensure RBAC hides this from customers.
- We should capture a short sample of raw streaming frames when a stream-reset occurs and attach to the canary event for offline analysis.

Follow-ups for next sync
- Quick status on Tom's shim + canary results (5 min)
- Demo of 'Canary anomalies' panel wireframe (Priya) (5-7 min)
- ETA on schema patch and backfill decision (Lena/Diego) (5 min)

Meeting adjourned.

Raw links / references (copied for convenience):
- Rollout ticket: JIRA-ROLL-204
- Analytics ticket: JIRA-ANALYTICS-78
- Console PR: github.com/redwood/console/pull/6209
- Playbook: confluence://ConsoleRollouts/metrics-playbook
- Slack: slack://channel/console-rollouts

End of notes.
